description: The legs with their climbs flown, from the field (start_altitude_ft; null starts level) and at every step up, at the best rate in each leg's air and the climb speed; each leg's climb_min and the top of climb (toc). A climb is flown at its own ground speed, the climb speed's wind triangle in the leg's wind; a leg flown wholly in the climb states the climb's TAS, wind correction, headings, ground speed and fuel flow, so its ground speed times its time is its miles; a leg partly climbed keeps the cruise's, the climb's on its toc.
